notes.title: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process | Patch rolling out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings valued employees!

We are pleased to announce another update from the Game Development Sector:

A patch is rolling out to CorpoNation: The Sorting Process!

- Improved the sorting process, sample dragging/dropping
- Improved dragging/dropping of Nexus Device pieces
- Fixed issue with Nexus Device scrubber wheel
- Fixed issue with Fixer not updating samples
- Fixed issues with shift star ratings
- Forced overtime is now forced
- Ultimate Ringo Fighters max level will now correctly behave as max level
- Fixed Solitaire revealing sample attributes you haven't yet unlocked
- 100 Years Ringo plaque is now available to buy at the appropriate time (Please support the economy!)
- Fixed minor Catalog issues
- Improved finale translations

We thank all employees for their diligent work reporting issues that were prohibitive to their efficiency.

Please continue to work hard!

notes.title: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process | Patch rolling out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, CorpoNation employees!

I have an update from the Game Development sector:

A small update is now rolling out to CorpoNation: The Sorting Process to resolve a number of issues as reported by our valued employees.

- Improved instances of some people experiencing save crashes
- Fixed an issue where you could only gift items in Catalog after Managers day (Please continue to support the economy!)
- Fixed an issue when buying Radio not unlocking the Radio button
- Fixed an issue where the Fixer would freeze in-game
- Improved Fixer's sample detection
- Improved assembly of the Nexus device base panels (You may notice pieces arranged differently, this is intended!)
- Fixed Challenges not resetting in Solitaire
- Fixed backgrounds/opponents not appearing in Ultimate Ringo Fighters
- Minor translation and localisation fixes

Ringo thanks you for your continued efforts to support the Game Development sector!

Work hard!
